verdict.rationale: Unstructured is an API-driven SaaS platform, so issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials is a fair question for it. The evidence pack does not show any scoped or permission-limited API keys. The only access controls documented are IP allowlisting, which restricts by network rather than by credential and requires a support ticket, and multi-user access on dedicated instances; neither amounts to per-agent credential scoping.
